name: You Make Me Feel Like A Natural Woman

podcast.body: Carole King co-wrote this song with Gerry Goffin, specifically for Aretha Franklin, based on a title concept from Atlantic producer Jerry Wexler. Franklin's rendition became an anthem of female self-actualization, prompting King to describe hearing it for the first time as a "rare speechless moment" that touched her more than any other recording of her own songs. "Carol King later wrote of Franklin's rendition quote, Hearing Aritha sing it for the first time, I experienced a rare speechless moment."

podcast.body: Carole King co-wrote this song, which became one of Aretha Franklin's greatest hits. King was the honorary at the 2015 Kennedy Center Honors, where Franklin performed the song, visibly moving King in the audience. "writer of one of Franklin's greatest ever hits, which the Queen of Seoul stepped out on stage, clad in a fur coat to perform live."
